notes: Original procedural models inspired by the supplied handmade clay figures.
Five original characters share a clay blob ghost body with distinct colors, silhouettes, eyes, and expressions.
Static meshes with named parts; no skeletal rig or embedded animation.
Clay surface uses actual geometry and vertex colors; no external textures required.
Digital game assets; overlapping parts are not prepared as a single watertight print.

characters.name: Blu
characters.title: The curious one
characters.description: A little cat, a little ghost, and entirely too interested in what is around the next corner. One bent ear. Two enormous, wandering eyes.

characters.name: Ember
characters.title: The lovable troublemaker
characters.description: A warm coral blob with crooked little devil horns and a grin that usually means trouble. Brave first. Thinks about it afterward.

characters.name: Moss
characters.title: The sleepy old soul
characters.description: Ash-gray clay, tall cat ears, and the very slow blink of someone who has seen a lot of adventures. The steady heart of the group.

characters.name: Mallow
characters.title: The shy daydreamer
characters.description: A squishy lilac ghost with one folded ear and a very small, very brave smile. Quietly notices the things everyone else misses.

characters.name: Glim
characters.title: The golden oddball
characters.description: One huge eye, one unruly horn, and absolutely no idea how to be subtle. A sunny little mischief-maker with a nose for adventure.
